deskNote: Crude / energy risk is today's first filter because geopolitical escalation is a risk-off cue that India must verify through crude, gold, USD/INR, FII flow and breadth. Track Nifty VWAP against 23,643.5; sentiment at 0.03 says the first range must prove direction. Sector breadth decides whether a Nifty move becomes a trend; Bank Nifty VWAP hold is the minimum bar. Let the first 15 minutes print, then trade only the side that holds VWAP with breadth behind it.
